StringTheory — Official MCP Server & Civic Research Skills

Connect the dots. Find the story.
Nonpartisan U.S. money-in-politics, congressional voting records, clause-by-clause bill text X-rays, lobbying disclosures, STOCK Act trades, and verifiable primary-source receipts for AI agents.

Developer Portal · Web App · Privacy Policy · Terms of Service

--- ## Overview `PQ-stringtheory/stringtheory-plugin` is the official unified plugin and Model Context Protocol (MCP) package for **StringTheory** (`https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp`). A single repository powers seamless installation across **Google Antigravity**, **Gemini CLI**, **Anthropic Claude Code & Claude Connectors**, **Cursor**, **OpenAI ChatGPT & Codex**, and the **Official MCP Registry** (`org.pqlabs/stringtheory`) — bundling: - **Remote Streamable HTTP MCP Server** (`https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp`) with **16 civic intelligence tools**, **Open Knowledge Format (`ontology://`) Civic Dictionary resources**, and **Google A2UI 1.0 (`ui://stringtheory/*`) interactive exhibits**. - **4 High-Signal Agent Skills** (`civic-research`, `money-to-vote-tracing`, `bill-xray`, `newsroom-receipt-verification`) teaching strict primary-source citation discipline (FEC, Congress.gov, Senate LDA, STOCK Act PTRs) and correlation-vs-causation guardrails. - **Dual Authentication**: 1. **1-Click OAuth 2.1 Sign-In (PKCE)** — sign in directly in your browser when prompted by your IDE or AI client (includes **Free `5 calls/day`** instantly, or inherits your paid plan). 2. **Headless / CI API Keys (`Bearer st_live_...`)** — mint scoped keys at [theory.pqlabs.org/developers](https://theory.pqlabs.org/developers) for automated workflows, CLI agents, and team environments. --- ## Quick Install Across AI Tools ### 1. Google Antigravity Install directly from GitHub or the Antigravity Agent Marketplace: ```bash agy plugin install PQ-stringtheory/stringtheory-plugin ``` - **OAuth 2.1 Sign-In**: Click **Sign in** when prompted in Antigravity's Plugins Manager to connect your StringTheory account in one click. - **Optional API Key (`Bearer st_live_...`)**: In `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "stringtheory": { "serverUrl": "https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer st_live_YOUR_API_KEY" } } } } ``` --- ### 2. Gemini CLI Install as a Gemini CLI extension (bundles `gemini-extension.json`, `GEMINI.md`, and the remote MCP server): ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/PQ-stringtheory/stringtheory-plugin ``` - On first tool invocation, Gemini CLI launches the OAuth 2.1 browser flow automatically, or you can pass an `Authorization: Bearer st_live_...` header in `~/.gemini/settings.json`. --- ### 3. Anthropic Claude (`Claude Code` & `Claude.ai Connectors`) #### Claude Code (Full Plugin: MCP + 4 Skills) ```bash claude plugin marketplace add PQ-stringtheory/stringtheory-plugin claude plugin install stringtheory ``` #### Claude Code (Direct MCP Server Only) ```bash # Interactive OAuth 2.1 Sign-In claude mcp add --transport http stringtheory https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp # Or with a headless st_live_... API key claude mcp add --transport http stringtheory https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp \ --header "Authorization: Bearer st_live_YOUR_API_KEY" ``` #### Claude.ai & Claude Desktop Connectors 1. Open **Settings -> Connectors -> Add Custom Connector**. 2. Enter URL: `https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp` 3. Complete the **1-click OAuth 2.1 Sign-In** flow in your browser. --- ### 4. Cursor Install **StringTheory** from the **Cursor Plugin Directory** (`.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`), or add to `.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "stringtheory": { "type": "http", "url": "https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp" } } } ``` - Cursor automatically discovers OAuth 2.1 on `https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp` and prompts **Connect** in MCP Settings. - For headless/key-based auth, add `"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer st_live_YOUR_API_KEY" }`. --- ### 5. ChatGPT & OpenAI Codex #### ChatGPT Connectors / Developer Mode 1. Open **Settings -> Connectors -> Create** (MCP Server). 2. Set MCP Server URL to `https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp` and complete OAuth 2.1 sign-in. #### OpenAI Codex CLI & Codex Plugin Directory (`.codex-plugin`) Install from the Codex Plugin Directory (or download the `.zip` archive from GitHub Releases), or add directly to `~/.codex/config.toml`: ```toml [mcp_servers.stringtheory] url = "https://theory.pqlabs.org/api/mcp" # Optional for headless API key auth (omit to use interactive OAuth 2.1): bearer_token_env_var = "STRINGTHEORY_API_KEY" ``` --- ## 16 StringTheory MCP Tools Every billable tool call is metered flat at **`1 call = 1 call`** — even multi-step `research_stringtheory` investigations. Protocol handshakes (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `prompts/list`) and `submit_mcp_feedback` cost **`0` quota**. | Tool | Category | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `research_stringtheory` | Deep Research | Primary multi-step civic research engine across bills, clauses, roll-call votes, FEC Schedule A/B/E filings, 2-to-4 hop graph paths, and STOCK Act PTR trades with verified Cloud Spanner receipts, A2UI 1.0 surfaces, Social Share Studio cards (`16:9` / `4:5` / `9:16`), and 4-format Work Exports (`article`, `policy_memo`, `legislation`, `report`). | | `ask_stringtheory` | Deep Research | Backward-compatible alias for `research_stringtheory` with identical live synthesis, citations, and Work Exports. | | `resolve_entities` | Entity Resolution | Fuzzy-search and resolve lawmakers (`bioguide_id`), bills (`bill_id`), federal races (`race_id`), PACs/committees (`committee_id`), and 56 policy initiatives (`initiative_slug`) with canonical deep links. | | `trace_connections` | Money & Graph | Bounded 2-to-4 hop Cloud Spanner `PoliticalGraph` path traversal (`from` + `to`) plus single-entity pre-vote STOCK Act PTR conflict tracing (`t_trade < t_action`) and 2-hop Donor -> Super PAC -> Candidate attribution. | | `search_bill_clauses` | Legislation | Hybrid full-text + vector Reciprocal Rank Fusion search across `bill_sections`, `committee_reports`, and Congressional Record `floor_speeches` (`CREC`) with `` GPO XML blocks stripped automatically. | | `xray_bill_and_amendments` | Legislation | Clause-by-clause bill X-ray classifying division/section policy mechanisms, mandates/prohibitions, buried omnibus riders (`buried_riders_only`), and 4-pattern Before vs. After floor amendment diffs. | | `generate_arguments` | Legislation | Steelman Pro and Con legislative arguments anchored to exact statutory clauses, dollar amounts, roll-call votes, and swing-member coalition signals. | | `get_politician_initiatives` | Accountability | Pre-materialized convictions across 56 policy initiatives, directional stance polarity (`-1.0` to `+1.0`), Effort/Effectiveness/Bipartisanship grades, and peer lift (`CONGRESS_119`, `CONGRESS_118`, `ROLLING_90D`, `ROLLING_365D`, `CAREER`). | | `inspect_race_and_outside_spending` | Campaign Finance | Reconciles candidate Form 3/3P fundraising with Super PAC Schedule E independent expenditures (periodic + 24/48-hour notices), Support vs. Oppose targeting, attack share, and outside-to-campaign ratios. | | `trace_politician_accountability` | Accountability | Combines 6-driver roll-call vote forecast waterfalls with donor-vote deltas, donor-bill deltas, 2-hop Super PAC attribution, and pre-vote STOCK Act PTR conflict receipts (`t_trade < t_vote`). | | `compare_members` | Voting Records | Head-to-head roll-call agreement rate, exact roll-call disagreements filtered by policy subject, and `closest_allies` (`other_party` bipartisan allies or `all` chamber peers). | | `rank_and_trend_members` | Voting Records | Multi-Congress career trajectories (107th–119th Congress vs. `peer_median`), chamber/party leaderboards (`party_breaks`, `party_loyalty`, `bipartisan_reach`, `missed_votes`, `bills_sponsored`, `became_law`), and 10% outlier checks. | | `trace_presidential_actions` | Executive Branch | Tracks presidential vetoes, pocket vetoes, executive orders, signed laws, and a lawmaker's veto-override roll-call votes (`member_on_vetoes`). | | `verify_political_claim` | Fact-Checking | Audits political, voting, statutory, or campaign finance claims with arithmetic and record-identity checks, returning `SUPPORTED`, `CONTRADICTED`, or `UNVERIFIED` plus `/r/...` evidence receipts. | | `find_story_leads` | Newsroom | Surfaces ranked investigative story leads across `defectors`, `buried_riders`, `stock_conflicts`, and `dark_money` over configurable time windows (`24h`, `7d`, `30d`, `119th`). | | `submit_mcp_feedback` | Feedback (`Free`) | Sends bug reports, data quality notes, or feature requests directly to the StringTheory team at **`0` quota cost**. | --- ## 4 Bundled Agent Skills | Skill | Directory | Focus | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`civic-research`** | `skills/civic-research/SKILL.md` | Entity resolution, multi-hop civic investigations, head-to-head member comparisons, multi-Congress career trends, presidential action tracking, and nonpartisan primary-source citation rules. | | **`money-to-vote-tracing`** | `skills/money-to-vote-tracing/SKILL.md` | Following campaign contributions, 2-hop Super PAC independent expenditures, lobbying filings, and pre-vote STOCK Act trades (`t_trade < t_action`) to roll-call votes — strictly separating statistical association/sequence from unproven quid-pro-quo causation. | | **`bill-xray`** | `skills/bill-xray/SKILL.md` | Clause-level statutory text search, ``-clean GPO parsing, buried omnibus rider detection, 4-pattern floor amendment diffs, and steelman Pro/Con impact analysis. | | **`newsroom-receipt-verification`** | `skills/newsroom-receipt-verification/SKILL.md` | Atomic fact-checking of political claims, FEC/roll-call arithmetic verification, and evidence-backed investigative lead discovery. | --- ## Plans & Flat `1 Call = 1 Call` Quotas Manage your OAuth connections, `st_live_...` API keys, and usage at **[theory.pqlabs.org/developers](https://theory.pqlabs.org/developers)**. | Tier / Pack | Included Allowance | Auth Methods | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Free** | **`5` calls / day** | OAuth 2.1 Sign-In | Instant zero-key trial across Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity | | **Pro** | **`1,000` calls / month** | OAuth 2.1 + `st_live_...` API keys | Flat `1 call = 1 call` metering across all 15 billable tools | | **Builder** | **`5,000` calls / month** | OAuth 2.1 + `st_live_...` API keys | Ideal for daily agentic workflows, civic apps, and policy analysts | | **Scale** | **`20,000` calls / month** | OAuth 2.1 + `st_live_...` API keys | Built for newsrooms, research desks, and high-throughput pipelines | | **`mcp_2k_pack`** | **`+2,000` calls / pack** | Automatically drawn down after base quota | Top-up add-on pack (`submit_mcp_feedback`, `ontology://`, and `ui://` reads are always `0` cost) | --- ## Repository Layout ```text stringtheory-plugin/ ├── assets/logo.png # 512x512 StringTheory 3-node civic mark ├── skills/ │ ├── civic-research/SKILL.md │ ├── money-to-vote-tracing/SKILL.md │ ├── bill-xray/SKILL.md │ └── newsroom-receipt-verification/SKILL.md ├── plugin.json # Google Antigravity root manifest ├── .antigravity-plugin/plugin.json # Google Antigravity scoped manifest ├── mcp_config.json # Google Antigravity MCP server config ├── gemini-extension.json # Gemini CLI extension manifest ├── GEMINI.md # Gemini CLI context & citation rules ├── .cursor-plugin/plugin.json # Cursor Marketplace manifest ├── mcp.json # Cursor MCP server config ├── .claude-plugin/ │ ├── plugin.json # Anthropic Claude Code plugin manifest │ └── marketplace.json # Anthropic Claude Code marketplace catalog ├──
